title: Java Streams, Lambdas & Modern Java
intro: Streams and modern Java features interviews test whether you use the functional style fluently. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with lambdas and functional interfaces (the foundation — SAM, method references), then the Streams API (the centerpiece — lazy, short-circuiting, collectors), then Optional (the null-handling companion). From there it moves through Java version features (9-11, 14-17, 21) in release order so a learner sees the language evolve. It closes with comparisons and scenario-based questions.
